content:
Critics mocked the living daylights out of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Monday after he posted an image of himself as James Bond.

Kennedy used AI to alter a new 007 publicity image released as part of the announcement that Robert Pattinson would be the next actor to play the legendary spy.

He replaced Pattinson’s face with his own ― and instead of a gun, Kennedy is armed with a carrot.

“Food. Real Food,” he wrote:

But his timing couldn’t have been worse: Kennedy’s post comes just days after the United States lost its measles elimination status as cases rise dramatically under his watch.

Kennedy is a notorious vaccine skeptic who has been trying to change the childhood vaccine schedule based on debunked claims and pseudoscience.

Given that background, critics were in no mood to indulge his attempt at a playful meme:
